ns2:section.sectionText: Online scheduled class sessions require each student to have high speed internet access and either a headset with microphone or an external microphone and speakers so they may participate in the class discussions. Wireless internet is not recommended. This section is restricted to online programs only.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to MS:Crop Sciences -UIUC, MS: FSHN (Online) -UIUC, MS: Agricultural Educ -UIUC, MS:Nat Res Env Sci -UIUC, or NDEG:Grad Nondegree-CE-UIUC.
